name: Sung in Flame
source:
In a world torn between the oppressive monopoly of the EOC Corporation and the rebellion fighting against it, you play as Elara, a pharmaceutical researcher bound to the very system she serves. 

Your direct superior, Corvin, is an opportunist clawing his way to the top—yet his unsettling interest in you complicates his ambitions.

But everything changes when, one fateful night, you save a wounded man— from the rebellion. 

[From [url=https://midnighteclipsy.itch.io/sung-in-flame]itch.io[/url]]
